Hygiene is a building decision, not a cleaning routine
IAQ company profile
The food and beverage industry relies on stringent quality and safety standards.

Stringent quality and safety standards govern the whole facility, from the structure through the process utilities to the waste stream. They are designed in first, proven at commissioning, then maintained for the life of the plant.

One accountable team, every system

IAQ understands the importance of adhering to these standards, and our facilities are designed and constructed with utmost cleanliness and safety in mind.

We deliver the whole facility, from structure to process utilities and waste, so clients can operate with confidence.

A hygienic specification, not an ISO class

Food and beverage projects on the record carry a hygienic specification rather than an ISO cleanroom class. Cleanliness is designed into the layout, the finishes and the process utilities, then proven at commissioning before the first production run.
